sections.title: First sign-in
sections.lead: Open the link from the EHS Center in your phone browser. We suggest "Add to Home screen" so it opens like an app.
steps: Tap your department.
Tap your name in the list.
Enter the 4-digit PIN from the EHS Center.
Tap "Confirm, I am ○○○" at the bottom. You sign in only once; afterwards it opens straight to Home.
sections.tip: Keep your PIN to yourself. If you forget it, ask the EHS Center to reset it.

sections.title: Signature (only once)
sections.lead: Your signature is saved and added automatically each time you submit — no daily signing.
shots: You can also upload a photo
steps: In the box, sign your full name horizontally with your finger; or sign with a black pen on white paper, take a photo and tap "Upload signature photo" — the background is removed automatically.
Tap "Next: vertical signature"; the system turns it vertical and shows you.
If every character is complete and in order, tap "Use this vertical one". If not, tap "I will sign myself" and sign top to bottom in the box.
sections.tip: To change your signature later: Home → "Settings" → "My signature".

sections.title: Understanding Home
sections.lead: The top of Home tells you how many things are left today. Just work through "To do" from top to bottom.
steps: Dark blue box: how many things are left today and the daily-check progress bar.
To do: today's forms, returned items to fix, periodic inspections due soon, monthly submission — work from top to bottom.
Tiles below: My forms, Ask a coworker, Notices, Calendar, Monthly records, Reminders, Settings.
"Online / Offline" at top right: you can still fill in offline; it uploads when the network is back.

chapters.title: Inspector
chapters.who: Check before work every day, submit once a month

sections.title: Daily checks
sections.lead: Before work, open today's form, check each item and submit.
steps: On Home, under "To do", tap "Start checking".
If everything is fine, tap "All OK" to tick all at once. For a problem item tap "Abnormal"; a note box appears — describe the problem and what you did (required).
If there is no work that day, tap "No work today".
The bottom button shows the next step: items left, items needing a note. When all is done it becomes "Submit this form".
Your signature is added when you submit. To change it the same day, open the same form, edit and submit again.
sections.tip: Use "Not ticked" / "Abnormal" at the top to show only those items — handy for long forms.

sections.title: Calendar · Fill in missed days
sections.lead: Tap a missed day on the calendar to fill it in.
steps: On Home tap "Calendar · Fill in missed days".
Green = checked, red = abnormal, grey dashed = weekday with no record.
Tap the missed day to fill it in (back to the 1st of last month).
Switch forms at the top. "Table (by item)" shows every item for the whole month.
sections.tip: Please check and fill in on the same day. Late entries record the time and are visible to supervisors and EHS.

sections.title: My forms
sections.lead: Every form assigned to you and periodic inspection deadlines, on one page.
steps: On Home tap "My forms".
Daily checks: whether today's is done.
Periodic inspections: monthly, yearly and 2-yearly forms with last date and next deadline; Home reminds you 30 days before.
Tap any form to start.
sections.tip: Yearly and 2-yearly inspections have no fixed day — inspect on site before the deadline, then fill in.

sections.title: Yearly and 2-yearly inspections (photos and notes required)
sections.lead: Forms that need a detailed on-site inspection — local exhaust, chemical equipment, ovens, boilers, elevators — must include evidence.
steps: These forms have no "All OK" — inspect each item on site and tick them one by one.
Scroll to "Inspection evidence" at the bottom and write inspection notes (at least 15 characters: what you checked, how, and the readings).
Tap "Take / choose photo" and take at least 2: the parts checked, meter readings or the nameplate. They upload right away (network needed); tap × at top right to remove a wrong one.
When everything is in, the bottom button becomes "Submit this form". Supervisors see the notes and photos, and they are printed in the monthly PDF.

sections.title: Ask a coworker to fill in (on leave)
sections.lead: When you're on leave, a coworker can fill in that day's daily check.
steps: On Home tap "Ask a coworker to fill in" and choose the day (up to 7 days ahead).
Tap "Create fill-in link" and send it to your coworker on LINE.
The coworker doesn't sign in; they open the link, fill in the day's form, and sign by hand on the spot when sending.
The link only works on that day and expires at 23:59.

sections.title: Claim forms
sections.lead: You can claim forms or equipment that are open for your section but not yet assigned to you.
steps: At the bottom of "My forms" tap "Claim other forms or equipment in this section".
Find the form or equipment and tap "Claim".
It then appears on Home. To cancel, ask your supervisor or the EHS Center.

sections.title: Monthly submission (once a month)
sections.lead: After each month, the whole section's records go to the supervisor for review. Any one person can send them.
steps: From the 1st of the next month, Home shows "Submit the records for month ○" (due by the 5th).
Check the calendar for missed days and fill them in, then tap "Month done — lock and send to the supervisor".
The check page lists how many days each form was done. Tick "I have checked nothing is missing" and tap "Confirm and submit".
After sending it is locked and cannot be changed; to change it, the supervisor must return it. Before the supervisor reviews it, the sender can withdraw it.

sections.title: Notices and announcements
sections.lead: Assignment changes, returns and EHS Center announcements all appear in the app.
shots: Announcement at the top of Home
Read full text on the Notices page
steps: EHS Center announcements appear in a red box at the top of Home. Tap "Read full text".
After you read it, it leaves Home; you can see it again in "Notices".
Changes to your forms or equipment and returned months are also explained in Notices.

sections.title: Issue tracking (corrective actions)
sections.lead: Items marked "Abnormal" move to "Issue tracking" automatically. An issue closes only when you record how it was fixed.
shots: You can attach photos of issues
steps: When you mark an item "Abnormal", besides the note you can tap "Add photo (optional)" to photograph the problem.
After submitting, the item appears in "Issue tracking" (red box on Home; the supervisor is notified). If it happens again before being fixed, it is added to the same issue, not duplicated.
When fixed, tap "Record fix" in "Issue tracking": write the corrective action, choose the date fixed, and optionally add a photo.
Tap "Fixed — close"; the person who found it and the supervisor are notified.
sections.tip: If you marked "Abnormal" by mistake, change it back to OK the same day and resend; the issue is cancelled automatically.

chapters.title: Unit supervisor
chapters.who: See progress, review monthly, assign work in your department

sections.title: Home and section status
sections.lead: See at a glance which sections have not checked today, where the issues are and how many reviews are waiting.
steps: To do: months waiting for your review are listed here. Tap "Start review".
Section status: one card per section; collapsed it shows today's progress, expanded it shows who did each form and how many days this month.
Sections with issues are listed first.

sections.title: Monthly review
sections.lead: After inspectors submit, you review, sign and approve; then it goes to EHS for archiving.
steps: Switch forms at the top to see the calendar or item table; for periodic inspections open the photos and notes.
If all is fine tap "Approve and sign"; your signature is added and a PDF is created.
If there is a problem tap "Return" with a reason; inspectors fix it and resend.

sections.title: Department
sections.lead: Assign who handles which forms and equipment in your department; adjust here when staff change.
steps: On Home tap "Department"; it has three tabs: People, Forms, Equipment.
People: whether each person has signed in and signed, and what they handle; tap a person to tick their forms and equipment.
Forms / Equipment: current owner, last periodic inspection and deadline; tap an item to change its owner.
Then tap "Effective today" (changes now) or "From next month" (no change this month, switches on the 1st). People involved are notified.
sections.tip: To add or disable people, forms or equipment, ask the EHS Center.

sections.title: Archive
sections.lead: After the supervisor approves, EHS checks the PDF and archives it — the month is complete.
steps: On Home under "To do" tap "View PDF and archive".
Tap "Open PDF" to check; if fine tap "Approve and archive", otherwise return it.
PDFs are saved to Drive and the NAS automatically.

sections.title: Announcements
sections.lead: Send notices to everyone, selected departments or people, and see who hasn't read them.
steps: On Home tap "Announcements".
Choose recipients: everyone, selected departments (option: "Only to supervisors"), or selected people.
Write a title (shown at the top of Home) and content; tick "Also email" if needed.
Tap "Send announcement". Under "Sent announcements" see how many have read it; open one to see who has not.

faq: Can I fill in without a network?
Yes. It is saved on the phone and shows "waiting to upload"; it uploads automatically when online and will not be lost.
Open the same form the same day, edit and send again. If the month is already locked, ask your supervisor to return it first.
New phone or cleared the browser?
Just sign in again with your PIN; your signature is stored in the system, no need to sign again.
Ask the EHS Center to reset it. The old PIN will stop working.
Send a link with "Ask a coworker to fill in", or fill it in on the calendar when you are back (marked as late entry).
Go back to Home when done and the app updates itself; records not yet uploaded are kept.
It is not assigned to you. Go to "My forms" → "Claim", or ask your supervisor to assign it in "Department".
Do yearly forms always need photos?
Yes. Yearly and 2-yearly inspections need site evidence: at least 2 photos + notes before they can be sent.
Yes. It stays in "Issue tracking" until a corrective action is recorded; supervisors and EHS see how many are open.
